plan.notes: Source: official BS CSE curriculum sheet, 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering, Individualized Specialization Option,' marked 'Effective Term: Autumn 2024' and 'Rev 07/29/2025,' published as Appendix A in the official Ohio State Office of Academic Affairs proposal document (http://oaa.osu.edu/sites/default/files/documents/ASC%20-%20Proposal%20to%20revise%20the%20BS%20and%20BA%20Computer%20Information%20Science.pdf); the sheet itself directs readers to the CSE department (cse.osu.edu) for more information. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from that sheet's official 'Sample Schedule.' Cross-checked against the CSE-department-hosted 2023-03 curriculum sheet (Effective Term: Autumn 2022, https://cse.osu.edu/sites/default/files/2023-03/CSE-Curriculum-Sheet-New-GE-IND-sample-schedule-with-GE-FINAL-1.pdf) and official OSU department course listings (math.osu.edu 2024-2025 course listing; stat.osu.edu STAT 3470.01 page). Catalog year '2024-2025' reflects the sheet's stated Effective Term: Autumn 2024. Transcription method: manual transcription of the printed Sample Schedule; no courses, credits, or titles invented. CAVEATS: (1) The schedule prints 'MATH 1152 3' in Year 1 Spring, but MATH 1152 (Calculus II) is officially 5.0 credit hours (math.osu.edu) and the printed 15-hour term total requires 5; transcribed as 5. (2) The schedule prints 'STAT 3470 4' in Year 2 Autumn with an 18-hour term total, but STAT 3470 is officially 3 credit hours (stat.osu.edu course page; also listed as 3 in this sheet's own Required Non-Major Courses table and in all prior official sheets); transcribed as 3, making Year 2 Autumn 17 hours. (3) Year 3 Autumn prints 'ECE 2060,' but ECE 2060 (Introduction to Digital Logic) already appears in Year 2 Spring, and the sheet's Required Non-Major Courses table requires ECE 2360 'Electronics for CSE Majors' (3 hrs), which appears nowhere else in the 4-year plan; transcribed as ECE 2360. (4) Credit total 129 reflects the CSE 2501 (1 cr) ethics path plus the conditional Year 3 Spring GE Theme (4 cr); the PHILOS 2338 (4 cr) path totals 128 because PHILOS 2338 overlaps the Citizenship theme. The sheet states a minimum of 126 total credit hours. (5) The source schedule does not list per-course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty and external_prereqs is empty. (6) Per the schedule, CSE 2221 requires a C or better for admission to the major. (7) Majors must select a specialization option; specialization requirements may dictate core/technical elective choices.
